name: IberAnime Porto 2026
description: Japanese pop culture takes center stage at Exponor this weekend. Dive into the world of manga, anime, cosplay, and gaming at one of the country's biggest conventions for fans.
longDescription:
IberAnime Porto 2026 is a two-day convention dedicated to Japanese popular culture, organized by IberAnime. It serves as a gathering point for enthusiasts of Japanese animation, comics, video games, and related cultural phenomena, aiming to foster community and provide a platform for engagement with these interests. The event is one of the largest of its kind in Portugal, drawing a significant number of attendees each year.

Visitors to IberAnime Porto can expect an immersive environment focused on various aspects of Japanese entertainment. The atmosphere is generally energetic, catering to a diverse audience ranging from dedicated fans and cosplayers to casual attendees interested in exploring the culture. The event takes place at Exponor, a large exhibition center in Matosinhos, providing ample space for its multiple activity zones and vendor stalls.

Admission to IberAnime Porto 2026 is ticketed. Exponor is accessible by public transport; bus lines connect the venue to central Porto. The event is family-friendly, welcoming attendees of all ages.
